latest.title: First release
highlights: Three working machines: the RD-30 glass-front snack machine, the RD-90 can machine and the RD-15 wall-mounted pre-roll vendor.
Buy on the machine itself: keypad, lit buttons or coins and a pull knob, then take it from the tray.
Real stock, public machines that refill, and business machines with keys, restocking, prices and a cash box.
Place machines in game, rob them by smashing, forcing the door and the cash box, and add liveries with no rebuild.
Qbox, QBCore or ESX, with ox_inventory or qb-inventory and ox_target, qb-target or lation_interact.
